name: Bonanza Billion Merge Up+

features.name: Merging clusters
features.description: Four-symbol clusters pay and merge into higher-level symbols.

features.name: Additive multipliers
features.description: 2x–100x multipliers in free spins add together.

review:
Bonanza Billion Merge Up+ fuses BGaming's two biggest engines: the Bonanza Billion fruit theme and the Merge Up cluster mechanic. Four or more adjacent symbols form a cluster, and after the win pays, symbols disappear and merge into higher-level ones.

Four, five or six scatters award 10, 20 or 30 free spins, and three or more scatters in the round add five more. Multiplier symbols only appear in free spins, taking values from 2x to 100x, and several multipliers add up at the end of a sequence. Chance x2 and a bonus buy are available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 15,000x maximum and a 97.04% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 386 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.04% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 386 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
